hero.h1: Design-Build Remodeling in Ann Arbor, From Sketch to Last Coat
hero.subheadline: Wright's Renovations designs, prices and builds kitchens, baths, basements and additions out of its Ypsilanti shop. One project manager stays with your house from contract to warranty visit.

image.alt: Design-build remodeling Ann Arbor area kitchen by Wright's Renovations: navy cabinets, white quartz counters, gray subway tile backsplash and stainless appliances

paragraphs: Wright's Renovations offers design-build remodeling in Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti and four more Southeast Michigan counties. Design, permits, construction and finish work stay under one roof. Six specialized crews work out of one shop on Platt Road, and every house gets one project manager from contract to the warranty visit.

The team plans around the age of your house. Pre-1920 homes in the Old West Side bring balloon framing and knob-and-tube wiring. Royal Oak bungalows often need a flush beam to open the kitchen, and 1960s ranches may hide aluminum branch wiring. Those known issues go into the proposal from the start instead of turning up later as change orders.

services.h2: Design-build remodeling in Ann Arbor, room by room

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full gut renovations, layout reworks and kitchen additions, starting from $75K. Cabinet orders go in the week you sign selections, so the longest-lead item never holds up the build. Most kitchens take 6 to 10 weeks, and recent ones run from Ann Arbor to Belleville.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with navy island, white quartz top, wood and leather stools, brass faucet and a single pendant light

items.name: Bathroom Renovation
items.blurb: Primary suites, wet rooms and half baths, from $40K. Every shower pan sits on a bonded membrane and gets a flood test before tile goes up. Heated floors are a common add in Michigan. Bathrooms carry a five-year craftsmanship warranty.

image.alt: Dexter, MI bathroom remodel with green wall tile, brass fixtures, soaking tub and wood vanity

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Family rooms, theaters, in-law suites, wet bars and steam showers, from $70K. Before framing, the crew checks the perimeter drain, the sump and the grade outside. Any basement bedroom gets a code-compliant egress window cut in.

image.alt: Finished basement home theater with sectional sofa and wall-mounted TV built by Wright's Renovations

items.name: Home Additions
items.blurb: Second-story builds, primary suite additions, ADUs and in-law suites, from $185K, with engineered drawings and full permitting handled. In-law suites with a first-floor bath are the fastest-growing request across all six counties the firm serves.

image.alt: Ann Arbor, MI home office addition with deep green walls and a desk by the window

items.name: Decks and Outdoor Living
items.blurb: Composite and hardwood decks, three-season rooms and covered patios, from $45K. Footings go below the frost line, and framing is sized for Michigan snow load rather than for the 70-degree day it was built on.

image.alt: Composite deck and patio with outdoor dining set beside a navy blue sided house

items.name: Whole-Home Renovation
items.blurb: Down-to-studs rebuilds, historic restoration and full-floor reworks, from $350K. Work is phased so families can often stay home. On Craftsman and Victorian houses around Ann Arbor, the crew mills trim profiles to match what is already there.

image.alt: Plymouth Township, MI whole-home renovation with new hardwood floors, oak and metal railings and an open kitchen

why_choose_us.h2: Why six-figure clients sign with Wright's

items.title: A fixed number before the contract
items.text: You get a fixed-scope proposal with line-item materials and labor before you sign. Change orders run under 5%, and most projects close at the original signed number.

items.title: See it before demolition
items.text: An in-house designer measures your home, builds 3D renderings and sources materials as part of the scope. You see the finished room and every line item before you commit.

items.title: Daily photos in JobTread
items.text: Your project manager posts site photos to JobTread every day, along with the schedule, documents and invoices. You can check progress from a meeting without making a phone call.

items.title: A clean, livable house
items.text: Zip-wall dust barriers, ram board floor protection and daily cleanup come on every job. Google reviewers call out the punctual crew and the tidy workspace.

about.h2: Started at 19 with one pickup truck
about.text: Connor Wright founded Wright's Renovations in 2021 at age 19, with one pickup truck. More than 550 projects later, the company ranked No. 610 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 and No. 2 in Ann Arbor. Connor is still the founder who walks sites and answers the phone. He also says no to a finish that will look dated before the warranty runs out. Will Sujek, Chief Revenue Officer since 2021, runs discovery calls and proposals. Katherine Anderson, Chief Administrative Officer since 2024, handles permits and insurance certificates. Clients name crew leads Charles and Chile and designers MacKenzie and Nick in their reviews.

process.h2: Four phases, documented the same way every time

steps.title: Week 1: Discovery call
steps.text: A working call about scope, budget and what the space must do. If your number and wish list do not meet, you hear it then.

steps.title: Weeks 2 to 3: Design and proposal
steps.text: In-home measure, 3D renderings, material selections and a fixed-scope proposal with real numbers, so you see the room and every line item first.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Zip walls up, ram board down and daily photos in JobTread. Permits are pulled on every job, and Wright's deals with the building department.

steps.title: Walkthrough and warranty
steps.text: Punch list, final inspection, care guide and warranty packet. Your one-year warranty visit is booked before the last truck leaves the driveway.

service_area.h2: About an hour from the Platt Road shop
service_area.text: Every crew leaves from one building at 7101 Platt Rd in Ypsilanti. The firm draws its line at about an hour on the road, so a crew that leaves at 6:45 is working by 8:00. Washtenaw County is home base. Wayne County runs about 25 minutes out, Livingston 30, Oakland 45 and Macomb 55. Monroe is about 25 minutes away. The company holds its license in all six counties.

faq.h2: What Ann Arbor homeowners ask before signing

items.q: What does a kitchen or bathroom remodel cost with Wright's?
items.a: The company publishes starting points. Kitchens start from $75K, bathrooms from $40K, basements from $70K, decks and outdoor work from $45K, additions from $185K and whole-home renovations from $350K. Your actual number comes as a fixed-scope proposal with line-item materials and labor after the in-home measure and design phase.

items.q: How long will my kitchen take?
items.a: Wright's lists a 6 to 10 week build timeline for kitchens. Before that, the discovery call happens in week one, and design and the proposal take weeks two and three. Cabinet orders go in the week you sign your selections, so the long-lead item does not hold up the schedule.

items.q: What happens if you find a problem behind the walls?
items.a: When a wall hides something, you get photos, three priced fixes and a recommendation within 24 hours. Known issues for your era of house are written in up front. For example, aluminum branch circuits in mid-1960s to early-1970s homes get pigtailed with approved connectors as a proposal line item, not a change order.

items.q: My house is in an Ann Arbor historic district. Can you still work on it?
items.a: Yes. Exterior changes inside Ann Arbor's historic districts go to the Historic District Commission before the building department, and Wright's budgets four to eight weeks for that review. The team designs to the commission's expectations from the start instead of appealing later, and mills trim to match original profiles on older houses.

items.q: Will you take a small job, like a door or a drywall patch?
items.a: Yes, through Wright's Repairs, a separate division with its own technicians and van under the same builder's license. Repairs are quoted in writing from photos and a short video, with a not-to-exceed ceiling. Each job gets before and after photos and one year on workmanship. It covers about 30 minutes from the Ypsilanti shop.

final_cta.text: Call Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm, or request a free consultation. You will get a straight answer on scope and budget on the first call.
